htglobalcircuits.com Revenue $70.4 Million HT Global Circuits is a private American PCB maker founded in 1990 in St. Petersburg, Florida, with 36 years of experience, over 1 billion boards shipped and 2000 plus customers. Led by CEO Ahmad Hamadeh, it uses a Blended Factory Model, quick turn and ITAR work at US plants in St. Petersburg and Milwaukee plus volume production with partners in China, Taiwan and Thailand. Its specialty is hard gold and selective gold plating for connectors, Type II gold at 30 micro inches, plus rigid, flex, rigid flex, HDI, RF up to 77 GHz, metal core and heavy copper boards. The Milwaukee plant came from the 2017 buyout of Pho-Tronics, a 50 year mil aero maker certified to MIL-PRF-55110. It holds ISO 9001, 14001, IATF 16949, AS9100D, ISO 13485, ITAR and UL, serving aerospace, defense, automotive and medical clients. 115.63 against US Navy contract N00024-24-C-6230, DPAS DO-A7  The defense chain  NAVSEA contract, CAGE 19623, GCN

cimmino.com Manifattura Foderami Cimmino is an Italian wholesale fabric distributor based in Naples with roots dating back to 1750, making it one of the oldest textile companies in Europe, now run by the Cimmino family, CEO Fabio Cimmino and CFO Antonio Cimmino. Operating from the CIS Nola wholesale hub, the largest distribution center in Europe, it stocks over 10 million meters of fabric and more than 1,000 fabric types, shipping worldwide within 48 hours through two in house quality labs. Its seven product lines cover linings, ready to wear fashion, bridal and ceremony, dance and events, carnival and party, bed and table linen including the Bellora brand, and upholstery, plus niche church vestment and medical fabrics. Clients include top fashion brands, linen designers and thousands of retailers across Europe, the Americas and Asia, and the company exhibits at Milan Unica and Messe Frankfurt textile fairs. Revenue stands at about 11.6 million euro in 2025 with 31 employees.

newteethnow.com 2420 over 707,000 files. New Teeth Now is a dental implant center in Lakeland, Florida famous for same day full mouth restoration, patients leave the same afternoon with a complete set of new teeth. Board certified surgeons Harley Richards and David Kirkpatrick have placed over 30000 implants in 30 years. The specialty is zygomatic implants anchored in the cheekbone for patients with severe bone loss rejected elsewhere, with no bone grafting and an All on X method using four to eight titanium Neodent implants per jaw. All work is under one roof in a 16000 sq ft center with an in house zirconia lab and general anesthesia. Pricing is all inclusive, zygomatic implants cost about 2000 to 4000 dollars each, financing through LendingClub and CareCredit is guaranteed. Patients come from all 50 states and abroad, four clinics in Florida and San Diego. Since 2022 owned by Frontline Dental Implant Specialists, a Leon Capital backed network.

nuovapsc.it 300GB Nuova PSC is an Italian engineering firm in Milan, continuation of Gruppo PSC, founded after WWII by Emidio Pesce and once a leader in technological systems for major works, which collapsed under 400 million euros of debt and entered concordato preventivo in 2022. Fund Nextalia acquired the group in 2024 and split it: Nuova PSC and Atisa sold to construction consortium Conpat on 25 July 2024, energy to Arcipelago, telecoms unit Italtel to Digital Value. Nuova PSC runs five business units, fire protection, naval, MEP, energy and public tenders, backed by 60 plus years of know how, ISO 9001, 14001, 45001, 50001, SA8000 and SOA class VIII for unlimited public contracts. Key customer is shipbuilder Fincantieri, with fire and water mist systems on cruise ships and Italian Navy vessels at Marghera, Monfalcone and Genoa yards. Offices in Rome, Milan, Ancona, Genoa and Copenhagen, revenue around 35 to 63 million euro, headcount up 126 percent.

mechanix.com 630GB Mechanix Wear American glove maker in Valencia, California, born in 1984 when Jim Hale built a glove for race mechanic Brian Lunnis, and in 1991 launched The Original glove at the Daytona 500, soon adopted by Dale Earnhardt's pit crew and all of NASCAR. Led by CEO Jesse Spungin and backed by private equity firm Gryphon Investors since 2020, it sells over 100 glove models in 20000 retail stores across 70 countries. Its flagship lines include The Original, FastFit and M-Pact impact gloves using TrekDry, D3O, Durahide leather and AX Suede materials. The company runs three divisions, consumer retail, industrial B2B, and tactical and military, holding a GSA contract, NSN catalog and Berry and TAA compliant lines used by US special forces and NATO troops. NASCAR partnership spans 30 years including the Most Valuable Pit Crew award. Under Gryphon it bought Chicago Protective Apparel in 2021, Kinco and Welch in 2025 and OTEX in 2026, building a full PPE platform.

stadtwerke-achim.de arbeiten-in-achim.de emobil-stadtwerke-achim.de  Stadtwerke Achim AG is a municipal energy utility in Achim, Lower Saxony, founded in 1910 as Gaswerk Achim AG and serving around 45000 customers across Achim, Oyten, Ottersberg and Langwedel. Owned 95 percent by the city of Achim and 5 percent by the municipality of Ottersberg, it is led by board member Sven Feht and employs about 100 people. It runs a 1170 km electricity grid, 985 km of gas pipelines and a district heating network fed by its own combined heat and power plant on Friedrichstrasse operating since 1983. Revenue reached 72 million euro in 2025 with a record 4 million euro profit, recovering after the 2023 gas crisis, and reliability is excellent at just 1.33 minutes of power outage per customer per year. Beyond electricity, gas and heat it offers photovoltaics with BayWa re, heat pumps on 15 year leases, EV charging with Mennekes and energy consulting, and it maintains 4500 LED street lights in Achim.

ugd.edu.mk Goce Delcev University in Stip, North Macedonia, is a state university founded in 27 March 2007 and named after the revolutionary Goce Delchev, now the second ranked university in the country. Led by rector Dejan Mirakovski, it unites 12 faculties and 3 art academies plus the associated Military Academy General Mihailo Apostolski across 4 campuses in Stip. Around 7000 students study over 70 programs from medicine and law to IT and film, with the Medical Sciences Faculty alone hosting half of all students and 600 plus international enrollees. Its strength is digitalisation, e-index, e-learning, an e-library with over 1000 titles and distance learning, plus a new UGD Startup Center. The university leads the e-Campus work package of the ACE2-EU European University Alliance, nine universities in nine countries, and holds 400 plus Erasmus agreements, the most of any Macedonian university. Roots go deeper than 2007, the Education Faculty traces back to a teachers school of 1946.

gagneraud.fr Gagneraud French construction group founded in 1880 in Paris by mason Jean Gagneraud and his sons, now run by the sixth generation under president Jean-Francis Gagneraud and CEO Eric Delamotte. It is the only ETI sized family group in French construction, organized as a network of around 50 autonomous regional companies across five regions, Normandy, Brittany, North, Paris and PACA. With 3k employees and revenue of about 700 million euro it covers public works, building, materials, recycling, energy and industrial engineering through flagship firms Gagneraud Construction, MARC SA, Cathelain and CG2i. The group is expanding beyond traditional BTP, buying solar and EV charging brand Fulgura, recycler SECAB, and in late 2025 the industrial engineering arms of Teams Ingénierie. Its energy transition includes Brittany's largest solar plant at Bruz with 38k panels, 300 EV charging points and 75k tonnes of recycled materials a year. 554 mill euro in 2020 to 717 mil in 2025.

tcindustries.com Revenue $242.9 Million TC Industries is a family owned industrial company founded in 1881, headquartered in Crystal Lake, Illinois, owned by the Berry family since 1935 and run by Bob and George Berry with the fourth generation Bert and Sterling Berry preparing to lead. It is the leading North American maker of cutting edges, wear parts and ground engaging tools for construction, mining and earth moving equipment, and the premier commercial heat treating provider in the region. Key customers are OEM giants Caterpillar, Volvo and Komatsu, and it is the largest independent producer of heat treated cutting edges in the US, Canada and Europe. Four plants in Crystal Lake, Guelph Ontario, Selkirk Manitoba and Skinningrove England employ over 500 people. The one stop shop covers cutting, CNC machining, heat treating, welding, carbide strips, painting and packaging, backed by ISO 9001, 14001 and 17025 certified quality.

arendal.com.mx Revenue $751.1 Million Arendal is a Mexican EPC contractor founded in 1995 in Monterrey, building oil and gas, power, infrastructure and mining projects with its own crews and equipment. It is Mexico's largest pipeline builder and a top two subsea installer in Latin America, with 200 plus projects, a one million pound HDD rig, saturation diving to ADCI and IMCA standards and pipelines moving 3,700 MMscfd of gas. Flagship works include the 452 km 42 inch Los Ramones II Norte gas pipeline with Odebrecht and Techint, Pemex subsea lines in the Bay of Campeche, the El Cuchillo II aqueduct for Monterrey and combined cycle plants up to 600 MW. With subsidiaries HOC Offshore and Arendal HOC Italy it now builds abroad: a 38 inch Vaca Muerta export pipeline in Argentina and a 43 km line for Mellitah in Libya. ISO 9001, 14001 and 45001 certified, 14 million man hours without lost time accidents. Past Pemex contracts have drawn ASF audit scrutiny.

steinecke.de Steinecke is a German family bakery group founded in 1945, based in Mariental, Lower Saxony, and run by the third and fourth generation Katrin and Felix Steinecke. It has 500+ branches in six states, three plants (Mariental, Berlin, Bernburg), about 3700 staff and 223 million euro revenue (2024), Germany's largest family owned bakery. Formats include own shops, in store bakeries in REWE, Netto and Marktkauf, railway and cafe sites under Brotmeisterei Steinecke, Ihr Bäcker and Heidebrot Backstube. Around 30 breads, rolls, cakes, snacks and coffee are sold, led by Hausbrot and Heidebrot from an 80 year old sourdough with 24 hour dough rest, baked on stone at nearly 400 degrees. It earned 39 straight DLG quality awards and topped the 2026 German Customer Award. It buys Bio and Fairtrade, uses green power, offsets CO2 and follows supply chain human rights rules. A cyberattack on 15 November 2026 hit its IT, but shops and production kept running.

berkeleyoralsurgery.com Berkeley-Orinda Oral Surgery is a private oral and maxillofacial surgery practice in Berkeley and Orinda, California, operating since the 1950s as one of the longest running oral surgery practices in the East Bay. The team of three to four surgeons, Bryan Krey, Daniel Mobati, Greggory Irving and newcomer Alex Romash, are all board certified in oral and maxillofacial surgery, with founders Richard Berger and Craig Bloom now retired. It covers the full scope of oral surgery, from wisdom teeth removal and dental implants to bone grafting, sinus lifts, facial trauma and corrective jaw surgery, with sedation and general anesthesia performed in the office and 3D cone beam CT imaging on site. The Berkeley office is at 2522 Dana Street Suite 202 with phone 510 848 1055, and the Orinda office at 3 Altarinda Road Suite 208 in the John Muir Health building with phone 925 253 1924, open Monday to Thursday 7 45 to 4 45, Friday 7 to 2, plus one Saturday a month for surgery.
